items.name: MvPolynomial.coeffs_one
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] : MvPolynomial.coeffs 1 ⊆ {1}

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeffs_C_subset
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (r : R) : (MvPolynomial.C r).coeffs ⊆ {r}

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial_mul'
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (m s : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : ((MvPolynomial.monomial s) r * p).coeff m = if s ≤ m then r * p.coeff (m - s) else 0

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeff_mul_monomial'
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (m s : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : (p * (MvPolynomial.monomial s) r).coeff m = if s ≤ m then p.coeff (m - s) * r else 0

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeffsIn_le
items.type: {R : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} {σ : Type u_4} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S] [Module R S] {M : Submodule R S} {N : Submodule R (MvPolynomial σ S)} : MvPolynomial.coeffsIn σ M ≤ N ↔ ∀ m ∈ M, ∀ (i : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPolynomial.monomial i) m ∈ N
